topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I found a time capsule in my backyard, and it's got me unsettled. The contents are old, sure, but they feel too personal, too familiar. There’s a journal, some photos, a few trinkets. I can’t shake the feeling that I should recognize everything inside. I’ve been going through the items, trying to jog my memory, but all I get are fleeting, half-formed thoughts that slip away as soon as I grasp at them. It’s strange, and I keep wondering what I’m missing. Maybe I should talk to an old friend or two, see if they remember anything. Or maybe it’s better to just let it be, keep it safe, and hope the answers come to me in their own time.
